references.text: The showbread was always to be placed before the Lord's presence as part of the holy furnishings of the tabernacle.
The Sabbath as an eternal covenant between the Lord and the children of Israel, a sign for all generations.
Describes the table of showbread and the continual bread that was to be set before the Lord's presence.
The Levites were responsible for the showbread and had to prepare it every Sabbath.
Solomon ensured the provision of the showbread as part of the regular service in the temple.
The priest Ahimelech gave David the holy bread that was replaced with fresh loaves on the Sabbath day.
The showbread is mentioned as part of the holiness of the tabernacle, a foreshadowing of Christ.
Jesus refers to David eating the showbread and highlights the sacred function of the bread.
